C1052.title: Hunan Mobile Assists Police in Cracking Government Server Room Intrusion Case
C1052.summary: Hunan Mobile assisted public security authorities in swiftly handling a case where criminals physically intruded into a government server room, tampered with communication lines, and used government landlines to commit telecom fraud.

references.title: Police-enterprise collaboration enables swift response: Hunan Mobile assists police in quickly solving a case involving intrusion into a government computer room...
